This maize plot is very small, so I will try to give it some manure and a little chemical fertilizer if I can get it from the cooperative. For seed, I will use my usual local seed because improved seed is costly and not always easy to get on time. I do not plan to spray chemicals or irrigate, because I depend on the rains and I do not usually use pesticide on maize. My family will do the work on this plot, and I will not hire labor.
